status: Implemented and verified against seven native cancellation cases, independent overwrite/pre-abort invariants, existing core cancellation tests and the isolated GUI suite.

boundaries.load: Cancel after native task 8 completes, with or without a prior image. The finished worker image is discarded. MainModel filename becomes empty; both Quick Save folders become the parent of the process working directory. Existing widget filenames, formats and disclosures remain.
boundaries.paletteAndSegmentation: Cancel after first-image task 2 or 3. The current model source is the first input and remains loaded. Quick Save fields retain their pre-batch values.
boundaries.smoothingAndFitting: Cancel after second-image task 4 or 5. The current model source is the second input and remains loaded. Quick Save fields retain their pre-batch values.
boundaries.export: Cancel after first-image task 6. The completed SVG remains on disk. The model source remains the first input and Quick Save fields retain their pre-batch values.

implementation.owner: GuiEngine uses one source-file metadata reset for both ordinary reset and completed-load cancellation. It clears the loaded file metadata/current source path and sends the existing empty-source event to QuickSave.
implementation.document: ImageDocument.cancelLoad already performs the native numeric/source reset. The metadata operation must not reset that document again or replace its session.
implementation.otherCancellation: Later completed-task cancellation retains the current source path and existing Quick Save fields. No new cancellation flag, alternate vectorizer or processing adapter is introduced.

evidenceLimits: Cancellation uses the existing native model hook after joining the selected task, before event-loop completion delivery. No native controls or dialogs are driven.
Raw clocks/durations are retained and validated with the existing timing comparator. Other state and native output bytes repeat identically.
Arbitrary in-task timing, overwrite-skip completion and active-job shutdown remain outside these captures.
Independent overwrite-skip and pre-aborted invariants are useful checks but do not establish unobserved native Quick Save skip-window behavior.
The seven cancellation cases use valid loads at the cancellation boundary; cancellation of an already failed load has not been captured.

verification.knownFailure: Existing processing-batch-controls setter-only backgroundMode 2 case; unchanged.
verification.beforeFix: Two load-cancellation comparisons fail with the original native expectations; evidence/quick-save-cancellation-before-fix-tests.txt.
